title: Saving Pocket Money
text:
Tom gets five euros pocket money every week. He saves most of his money in a small box. He wants to buy a new bike next summer. Sometimes he spends a little on sweets.

His sister Ana gets less money because she is younger. She likes to buy stickers and small books. Every Saturday, they count their money together. Their parents think saving is a good habit.

questions.text: How much pocket money does Tom get every week?
What does Ana like to buy?
Why do you think Tom wants to save money?
options: He wants to buy a new bike
He wants to buy sweets every day
He does not like his box
He wants to give his money away

questions.text: What can you infer about Tom and Ana's parents?
options: They think saving money is useful
They do not give pocket money

vocabulary.definition: keeps money for later instead of spending it
small pieces of food with a lot of sugar
having fewer years of age than someone else
the mother and father of a child

paragraph_translations: Tom recebe cinco euros de mesada toda semana. Ele guarda a maior parte do dinheiro em uma caixinha pequena. Ele quer comprar uma bicicleta nova no próximo verão. Às vezes ele gasta um pouco com doces.
A irmã dele, Ana, recebe menos dinheiro porque é mais nova. Ela gosta de comprar adesivos e livrinhos. Todo sábado, eles contam o dinheiro juntos. Os pais deles acham que economizar é um bom hábito.
